dogecoin.text: @TeslaAIBot @Tesla One cannot take out a loan in Dogecoin. How can we solve that problem in a way that makes sense?

@TeslaAIBot @elonmusk @wapodavenport Dogecoin is useful for cryptocurrency education. There is no upper limit on the number of Dogecoin, just as there is no upper limit on US Dollars. This defecit when more currency is issued doesn't get repaid, but the value gets diluted. Illogical and imperfect.
